cond_0001.intro:
We are looking for a Data Science, Visualization and Management Analyst to join our team.
Candidate should have baseline data management and visualization skills, be personable and self-starters willing to work with clients and integrate into an existing team. Ideal candidates will be independent and show initiative in operating apart from a [Company name masked] based team on the ground. Additionally, language capabilities in Mandarin or Korean would aid the work, as well as experience producing intelligence reports and evaluating intelligence production.
[Company name masked]'s Government and Public Services (GPS) practice - our people, ideas, technology and outcomes-is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of over 15,000+ professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise. The I&I team supports our GPS clients by delivering capabilities across the investigative lifecycle in the regulatory, civilian, law enforcement, health, and national security domains. Our professionals help our clients to identify, combat, and mitigate national security threats such as fraud, money laundering, sanctions violations, cybercrime, threats of terrorism, human trafficking, narcotics trafficking, litigations, and disputes.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree
2+ Years of Data Analysis, Data Visualization, Tableau, Data Management
Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future
Active TS/SCI with Polygraph security clearance
Preferred Requirements
Data Science Project Management
Strategic Data Analysis, Data Visualization
Language capabilities in Mandarin or Korean
